##### Project general facts

Equiterra 2 embodies the essence of equestrian sophistication through its architecture, landscape, and design. The project seamlessly unites nature and refinement, creating a lifestyle inspired by the heritage of polo and the comfort of modern luxury. Conceived as a haven of serenity and prestige, Equiterra 2 represents harmony between leisure, wellness, and connection - a vibrant community framed by lush greenery, sculpted lawns, and the graceful rhythm of equestrian life.

The development offers an exclusive collection of townhouse-plexes and five-bedroom luxury residences, each meticulously designed to reflect elevated living. Interiors take cues from the surrounding landscape, merging soft neutral tones with rich textures and exceptional craftsmanship. Expansive windows and open layouts strengthen the bond between indoor and outdoor spaces, filling each home with natural light, air, and tranquility. This design philosophy evokes timeless sophistication - elegant, grounded, and effortlessly refined.

Residents of Equiterra 2 are welcomed into a world of curated amenities centered around The Clubhouse, The Stables, and the Polo Fields. Complementary features include a linear park, riding arenas, yoga decks, an amphitheatre, fitness zones, swimming pools, padel courts, and children’s playgrounds. Every element is designed to nurture well-being, foster connection, and celebrate outdoor living - ensuring that life at Equiterra 2 flows with the same grace and balance as the sport that inspires it.

##### Location description and benefits

Discover the refined sophistication of the Grand Polo Club and Resort by Emaar - a distinguished retreat set within Dubai Investment Park 2. More than a residential address, it is a lifestyle destination where luxury meets sustainability. Surrounded by vast green landscapes and immaculate polo fields, the resort offers a serene escape for equestrian enthusiasts and those seeking a balanced, nature-infused way of living.

Its prime location provides effortless access to key destinations across Dubai, ensuring both convenience and connectivity. Every architectural and planning detail reflects Emaar’s dedication to comfort and visual harmony, combining modern amenities with a peaceful environment. Here, residents enjoy the perfect blend of contemporary elegance and natural beauty - from scenic horseback trails to tranquil moments in thoughtfully landscaped parks.

Built with sustainability at its core, the community integrates energy-efficient systems and eco-friendly materials, reaffirming Emaar’s commitment to environmental responsibility. Whether choosing a sophisticated villa or a stylish townhouse, homeowners at the Grand Polo Club and Resort are immersed in an experience where elegance, practicality, and forward-thinking design come together in perfect balance.
